results.title: Deb is Boss
results.overview: Before becoming a powerhouse music executive who launched Gucci Mane, Nicki Minaj, and French Montana, Deb Antney was a street-smart survivor navigating the dangerous underworlds of Queens, NY and Boston, MA. Balancing romance, ambition, and hustler instincts, she built an underground drug empire while dreaming of something bigger, laying the foundation for her eventual rise to the top of the music industry.

results.title: Oh Mom!
results.overview: How much is contained in these two words—irritation, tenderness, laughter, love. And a little shame, when she knows everything about you. Even what you yourself have forgotten. This film is about all mothers and for all of us. About those moments when you say, “Mooom, don’t start”—and she starts. About the calls with the question, “Have you eaten?” when you are in a courtroom or on a date. About superpowers that work even thousands of kilometers away.

results.title: Mongoose
results.overview: Captain Oleg Mangul travels to a remote town to investigate the mysterious disappearance of students, but soon realizes something is deeply wrong. Strange witnesses, eerie visions, and tracks leading into the mountains confront him with a mystery that defies human logic. Trying to escape this trap, Mangul finds himself drawn into a dangerous conflict where reality and deception intertwine, and his own past begins to play a decisive role.

results.title: Mulan: Light A fire
results.overview: After returning home from war, Mulan discovers her family shattered by corruption and violence. As she investigates the truth behind her brother’s death, she uncovers a vast conspiracy involving corrupt officials and ruthless merchants, forcing her onto a solitary path of vengeance and justice.

results.title: Exhibition Gala | ISU World Championships | Prague 2026
results.original_title: Exhibition Gala | ISU World Championships | Prague 2026
results.overview: Medalists and stars perform at the Exhibition of Champions at the ISU World Championships in Prague 2026

results.title: Scherbenland
results.overview: Spanning 50 years, the documentary traces a path through the Berlin district of Kreuzberg, linking the legacy of the rock band "Ton Steine Scherben" - best known for their work in the 1970s - with their successors.

results.title: Codes
results.overview: Following a major attack on British soil, a politician discovers the only way of saving his country is by killing the man in front of him.

results.title: Summer Days
results.overview: Summer is promising for Juan and Gabriela, who plan to have a beach house. However, their plans are disrupted when Juan's father arrives with his new, younger girlfriend, Mónica, causing tension and a challenging coexistence.

results.title: A Gangster's Life
results.overview: When two low-level criminals scam a vicious London mob and are in over their heads, they flee to rural Greece to avoid the bloody repercussions. But escape isn't that simple.

results.title: Stages
results.overview: After the tumultuous breakup of his band, Ben Garza embarks on his first-ever solo tour. Life on the road feels different now, and Ben must find his footing alongside Rita, his steadfast tour manager, and Jessie Ramos, his charismatic, spotlight-stealing opening act.

results.title: Bohemian Paradise
results.overview: Milan and Týna Svoboda’s marriage has, in recent months, turned into a series of minor and major misunderstandings, with the couple now arguing about almost anything. A holiday therefore seems like the right choice to save their relationship. But what if they each have a different idea of what that should be? Milan has a soft spot for the Czech countryside and is thrilled at the prospect of sleeping under the stars, whilst Týna would much rather be by the sea. She sees the campsite in the Bohemian Paradise more as a compromise. From the moment they arrive, even seemingly ordinary things turn into comical disasters that gradually escalate. Instead of relaxation, the tension between them only intensifies. After an unexpected incident at Trosky Castle, they decide to try something completely different – spending some time apart. Perhaps this way they’ll finally discover what’s really important in life…

results.title: while the gods were busy with another child
results.original_title: while the gods were busy with another child
results.overview: This deeply exploratory work is drawn exclusively from the eclectic personal and public archive, in multiple formats, of Andrea’s life until their lasting estrangement from both parents, aged 30.

results.title: Tiket Sehala
results.overview: Alif, Putri and Taqy, three Malaysians trapped in a human trafficking syndicate in South Korea, show the dark reality of labor exploitation and the struggle to return home.

results.title: The Lord of Cold
results.overview: Sisters Maria and Anastasia are best friends, and they cope not only with a grumpy mother, but also with ancient magic, because of which winter has not come in their village for many decades. The girls manage to overcome all obstacles, drive away the evil witch, melt the heart of the Lord of Cold, and also find love.

results.title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
results.original_title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
results.overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

results.title: Mr. Denver
results.overview: A stubborn young woman is purchased at a clandestine auction by a cold, ruthless billionaire. To pay off her debt, she is forced to serve as his personal assistant, only to discover that her employer is the head of a powerful mafia clan.

results.title: Edie Arnold Is a Loser
results.overview: Timid dork Edie accidentally takes the spotlight when she starts a punk band with her fellow “turds”, becoming an icon to the rest of the losers at her all-girls Catholic school while managing to piss off the hot girls, the nuns, and the horniest altar boy you’ve ever seen.

results.title: Mambo Maternica
results.overview: An adoption, an insemination, an abortion. Three women in three European cities struggle through a day, making one of the hardest decisions in their lives. An up-to-date observation of women’s choices on the verge of motherhood.

results.title: The Heir
results.overview: 18-year-old Viktor Mordem is torn from his human life and drawn into an isolated aristocratic vampire order, where an ancient ritual determines who is worthy to inherit power.
